playbooks.label: Callable acceptance can verify a bounded patch
playbooks.safe_next_step: run verifier gates against sandbox patch package

playbooks.label: Positive sample failed because a domain fixture is missing
playbooks.safe_next_step: add or select a controlled fixture/profile and re-run blind acceptance

playbooks.label: Optional dependency boundary requires a controlled profile
playbooks.safe_next_step: consume the manifest-backed isolated dependency profile without mutating the source project

playbooks.label: Acceptance contract does not bind to callable signature
playbooks.safe_next_step: send contract binding back to Implementer Planner or Spec Writer

playbooks.label: Import-time runtime behavior is not a safe executor patch target
playbooks.safe_next_step: isolate import-time side effects or choose a lighter target

playbooks.label: Bound method requires a controlled instance fixture
playbooks.safe_next_step: build a bounded instance fixture or rebind to a callable boundary

playbooks.label: Nested closure is not a standalone patch target
playbooks.safe_next_step: rebind to the enclosing callable or provide explicit closure inputs

playbooks.label: Observed output duplicates a delimiter present once in the expected value
playbooks.safe_next_step: trace the join boundary and normalize delimiters contributed by both adjacent fragments
playbooks.repair_guidance: Identify the repeated delimiter in the observed value. At a join, remove that delimiter from the right edge of the left fragment and the left edge of the right fragment, then insert exactly one delimiter. One-sided rstrip-only normalization is insufficient. Preserve internal delimiters and prove the exact counterexample.

playbooks.label: Observed text wraps the expected value in non-alphanumeric boundary noise
playbooks.safe_next_step: normalize allowed separators and trim rejected punctuation only at final output boundaries
playbooks.repair_guidance: Trace how punctuation and separators are mapped, collapsed, and trimmed. Preserve meaningful internal separators, but remove disallowed leading and trailing boundary characters after normalization. Replay the exact observed wrapper and already passing cases.

playbooks.label: Observed numeric sequence replaces an expected nonzero component with zero
playbooks.safe_next_step: trace token boundaries before numeric conversion and preserve numeric components across mixed separators
playbooks.repair_guidance: Extract numeric components across every contract-visible separator before defaulting missing values. Do not merge adjacent components or replace a present numeric token with zero. Preserve component order and replay exact mixed text-number inputs.

playbooks.label: Expected and observed text share content but differ in separator structure
playbooks.safe_next_step: preserve contract-visible internal separators while trimming boundary noise
playbooks.repair_guidance: Compare the exact expected and observed strings. Preserve the expected internal separator sequence and positions; change only the normalization step that removed, merged, or moved those separators, then trim rejected boundary punctuation separately.
